premises.text: Most people lack internet access despite widespread smartphones, which can be life-or-death and blocks growth
premises.evidence_span: 66% of the world has a smartphone in their hands, but 53% of the population does not have access to internet

premises.text: Current efforts to bring internet or offline apps to remote users are not scalable soon enough
premises.evidence_span: we don't feel that this is scalable. We don't feel that this is going to actually get to a lot of people real soon

premises.text: An SDK lets existing apps work offline by connecting phones over Bluetooth mesh networks
premises.evidence_span: Ridgefire is an SDK that apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline

premises.text: Mesh hopping extends range beyond 330 feet while algorithms limit flooding, message lifetime, and battery drain
premises.evidence_span: it creates mesh networks, which means that information can hop on devices found in the middle, so the range is increased

premises.text: The stack offers Android-to-iOS integration, encryption, and patents
premises.evidence_span: We are the only ones in the market with Android to iOS integration

premises.text: B2B model sells to developers who already have dense user bases rather than building a consumer app
premises.evidence_span: we're working on a B2B model. We cater to developers that already have this user density

premises.text: Pricing charges for monthly active users that use the partner app via the offline technology
premises.evidence_span: We charge based on monthly active users that use your app thanks to our technology each month

value.text: Apps keep working offline to connect people and save lives when internet is unavailable
value.evidence_span: imagine somebody being trapped in their building after an earthquake or stranded in a tsunami or after a tsunami. and being able to connect with rescue corps

secondary_value.text: Developers open and expand markets and revenue by serving offline moments
secondary_value.evidence_span: You open up new markets. You open and you blow up existing ones. So that translates into revenue

causal_links.evidence_span: It can be the difference between life and death
apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline
We cater to developers that already have this user density
when developers make this revenue, we also make it

notes: Mesh range, flooding/TTL/battery algorithm, and Android-iOS/encryption/patents folded as facets of the offline SDK mechanism (IP detail stays with mechanism). WhatsApp/Uber/broadcast examples treated as applications of one SDK, not separate premises. Raise amount and user-count traction excluded. Closing vision of city-scale standard recorded only via primary value, not as extra premise. Transcript ends mid-sentence.
